_comment: The source of truth for the app's text (#87). Keys are stable dotted names, never the English text; placeholders are {named}; plural entries are objects keyed by CLDR category. Plain text only: no HTML, no entities. See docs/UI_ARCHITECTURE.md, "Languages".

settings.language.help: System default follows the Windows display language when the monitor offers it, else English. Apply reloads the dashboard.

_note.widget.nostromo.guard.hold: Nostromo's widget header, the chip on the right while the usage guard holds and no resume time is known. In capitals.

_note.widget.nostromo.guard.time_left: Nostromo's hover card, the time left in the guard line: {countdown} as the app writes it (2H 14M). Kept on one line. In capitals.

_note.widget.nostromo.resets.at: Nostromo's hover card, under each row: when the limit resets. {clock} is the time (11:39 PM), or the weekday and the time on another day (SAT 8:12 PM). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.resets.unknown: Nostromo's hover card, under a row whose reset time is not known yet. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.none: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: no pace to tell (no reading or no reset time yet). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.on: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage keeps pace with the time gone in the window (within 10 points). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.ahead: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage is ahead of the time gone in the window. {points} is by how many percentage points, signed (+21). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.behind: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage is behind the time gone in the window. {points} is by how many percentage points, signed (-18). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.points: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: the short form of widget.nostromo.pace.ahead and .behind, for a line too tight for them (a long reset time). {points} is the signed percentage points (+21, -18); the tone says ahead or behind. English never shows it. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.live: Night City's widget header, the tag on the right while the numbers are live, and the strip's status tag then. In capitals, as all of Night City's words.
_note.widget.night_city.state.stale: Night City's strip, the status tag while the numbers shown are the last ones read (the sign-in needs the user). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.offline: Night City's strip, the status tag while there is no connection to the usage API. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.paused: Night City's strip, the status tag while updates are paused. Not the usage guard's hold (widget.night_city.guard.hold). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.loading: Night City's strip, the status tag while the first reading is awaited. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.rate_limit: Night City's strip, the status tag while the usage API is throttling the monitor (it retries by itself). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.no_credent: Night City's strip, the status tag while there is no sign-in. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.warning: Night City, the outlined chip after a row's name while that limit is at its warning level. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.state.critical: Night City, the filled chip after a row's name while that limit is critical. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.band.offline: Night City's stale band, the cause while there is no connection to the usage API, on one line with the age after it (widget.night_city.age.old). The band's other causes are widget.night_city.band.expired, .refused and .no_login. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.band.expired: Night City's stale band, the cause when the sign-in ran out (using Claude Code renews it), on one line with the age after it. {product} is Claude Code's name, in capitals. The band's other causes are widget.night_city.band.offline, .refused and .no_login. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.band.refused: Night City's stale band, the cause when the usage API turned the sign-in down (HTTP 403): only a new sign-in fixes it. On one line with the age after it. {command} is the sign-in command, as typed (in lower case). The band's other causes are widget.night_city.band.offline, .expired and .no_login. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.band.no_login: Night City's stale band, the cause when there is no sign-in at all: the dashboard has the steps. On one line. The band's other causes are widget.night_city.band.offline, .expired and .refused. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.hold: Night City, the usage guard's chip while it holds: in the header and the stale band when no resume time is known or the time left has no room, and always on the strip. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.hold_for: Night City, the usage guard's chip in the header and the stale band while it holds. {countdown} is the time left until work can resume, as the app writes it (2H 14M). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.mark: Night City's widget header, a quiet outlined chip while the usage guard is armed, drawn only where it fits. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.armed: Night City's hover card, the guard line while the guard is armed and watches no cap: the lead alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.armed_list: Night City's hover card, the lead of the guard line while the guard is armed, before the caps it watches (GUARD // ARMED: SESSION 95%, WEEKLY 90%). The colon is the language's; the lead is drawn on its own and never wrapped. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.holding: Night City's hover card, the guard line while the guard holds with nothing to list: the lead alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.holding_li: Night City's hover card, the lead of the guard line while the guard holds, before the limits at their caps and the resume time. The colon is the language's; the lead is drawn on its own and never wrapped. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.limit: Night City's hover card, a limit in the guard line: {name} is its name, as the rows name it (widget.night_city.limit.scoped for a scoped one); {percent} is its cap while the guard is armed, its reading while it holds (SESSION 96%). Kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.cap: Night City's hover card, after a limit's reading in the guard line while the guard holds: the cap it reached (WEEKLY 91% (CAP 90%)). {percent} is written as a percent. Kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.resumes: Night City's hover card, the guard line's last sentence while the guard holds: {clock} is the resume time (10:26 PM, or FRI 11:12 PM on another day), {time_left} the time left (widget.night_city.guard.time_left). The code adds the closing period. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.guard.time_left: Night City's hover card, the time left in the guard line: {countdown} as the app writes it (2H 14M). Kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.limit.session: Night City, a row's name and the guard line's: the 5-hour session limit. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.limit.weekly: Night City, a row's name and the guard line's: the weekly limit of all models. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.limit.scoped: Night City's hover card, the guard line's name for the weekly limit of one model or surface: {name} is its name, in capitals. A scoped row shows the name alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.limit.scoped_unn: Night City, a row's name and the guard line's: the weekly limit of one model or surface that has no name. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.window.session: Night City's strip, the label before its first bar: the 5-hour window. Two characters, as English's: the strip has no room for more. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.window.weekly: Night City's strip, the label before its second bar: the 7-day window. Two characters, as English's: the strip has no room for more. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.share.of: Night City, beside a scoped row's name: that limit's share of the weekly limit. {percent} is written as a percent. Left out where it does not fit. In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.cap.tag: Night City, the filled chip after a row's name while the usage guard holds on that row: the cap it reached. {number} is the cap, with no percent sign (CAP 95). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.resets.at: Night City, when a limit resets: beside the row on the widget (left out where it does not fit) and under it on the hover card. {clock} is the time (11:39 PM), or the weekday and the time on another day (SAT 8:12 PM). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.pace.none: Night City's hover card, right of the reset: no pace to tell (no reading or no reset time yet). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.pace.on: Night City's hover card, right of the reset: usage keeps pace with the time gone in the window (within 10 points). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.pace.ahead: Night City's hover card, right of the reset, in a chip: usage is ahead of the time gone in the window. {points} is by how many percentage points, signed (+41). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.pace.behind: Night City's hover card, right of the reset, in a chip: usage is behind the time gone in the window. {points} is by how many percentage points, signed (-18). In capitals.
_note.widget.night_city.age.old: Night City's stale band, after the cause: how old the numbers shown are. {age} is the age in its one unit, as the app writes it (41 M). Left out where it does not fit. In capitals.
